commons.title: 1924.KosiatyFamily.jpg
commons.description:
Kosiaty Family photo, between 1925–1927. Clockwise from top-left: kpt. Jan Kosiaty (1901–1940), Michał Kosiaty (22.10.1893–15.05.1968), Edward Kosiaty (1892–1934), Czesław Kosiaty (13.07.1910–20.07.1949), Zofia Kosiaty (1890-1963), Jan Kosiaty (1863-25.07.1928), Jadwiga Kosiaty (Magierowska primo voto Tabou)(1870–1956).
Jan(1901–1940), Michał, Edward, Czesław and Zofia were Jan's children from the first marriage with Jadwiga Michalska (1871-1914). Apart from these children they were also parents of Aleksander (1892–1923) and Romuald (1900–?)

Jadwiga Tabou was his second wife.
commons.editorial_reason: A named family portrait shows ordinary historical clothing but no distinctive cultural practice, dress, craft, or performance.
